name: Pro audio
description: Pro audio: balanced (hot/cold) and unbalanced (L/R) audio signals with their returns, lanes and line level; XLR3, RCA and 3.5 mm TRS bodies and pinouts (AES14 / IEC 61076-2-103, IEC 60603-11/-12); microphone and stereo stocks with their colour codes; an XLR microphone cable and a TRS-to-2×RCA Y lead with a breakout.
